output_fields: Order ID, Merchant ID, Amount, Currency, Order Status, Created At
report_criteria: Orders with a status of Paid or Cancelled, created between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31.
sql:
SELECT
  [o].[id] AS [Order ID],
  [o].[merchant_id] AS [Merchant ID],
  [o].[amount_units] AS [Amount],
  [o].[currency] AS [Currency],
  [o].[order_status] AS [Order Status],
  [o].[created_at] AS [Created At]
FROM [dbo].[order_record] AS [o]
WHERE
  [o].[order_status] IN ('PAID', 'CANCELLED')
  AND [o].[created_at] >= '2026-01-01'
  AND [o].[created_at] < '2026-04-01'
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
    WHERE
      [m].[id] = [o].[merchant_id] AND [m].[status] = 'ACTIVE'
  )

output_fields: Refund ID, Payment ID, Merchant ID, Refund Amount, Refund Status, Processed At
report_criteria: Refunds with a status of Processed, processed in the last 30 days.
sql:
SELECT
  [r].[id] AS [Refund ID],
  [r].[payment_id] AS [Payment ID],
  [r].[merchant_id] AS [Merchant ID],
  [r].[amount_units] AS [Refund Amount],
  [r].[status] AS [Refund Status],
  [r].[processed_at] AS [Processed At]
FROM [dbo].[refund] AS [r]
WHERE
  [r].[status] = 'PROCESSED'
  AND [r].[processed_at] >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, SYSUTCDATETIME())
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
    WHERE
      [m].[id] = [r].[merchant_id] AND [m].[status] = 'ACTIVE'
  )

output_fields: Order ID, Merchant ID, Customer ID, Amount, Currency, Order Status, Created At
report_criteria: Orders with a status of Paid, created in the last 90 days.
sql:
SELECT
  [o].[id] AS [Order ID],
  [o].[merchant_id] AS [Merchant ID],
  [o].[customer_id] AS [Customer ID],
  [o].[amount_units] AS [Amount],
  [o].[currency] AS [Currency],
  [o].[order_status] AS [Order Status],
  [o].[created_at] AS [Created At]
FROM [dbo].[order_record] AS [o]
WHERE
  [o].[order_status] = 'PAID'
  AND [o].[created_at] >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, SYSUTCDATETIME())
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
    WHERE
      [m].[id] = [o].[merchant_id] AND [m].[status] = 'ACTIVE'
  )

output_fields: Payment ID, Order ID, Merchant ID, Amount, Payment Method, Captured At
report_criteria: Payments with a status of Captured, made via UPI, with an amount of at least 1000.
sql:
SELECT
  [p].[id] AS [Payment ID],
  [p].[order_id] AS [Order ID],
  [p].[merchant_id] AS [Merchant ID],
  [p].[amount_units] AS [Amount],
  [p].[method] AS [Payment Method],
  [p].[captured_at] AS [Captured At]
FROM [dbo].[payment] AS [p]
WHERE
  [p].[status] = 'CAPTURED'
  AND [p].[method] = 'UPI'
  AND [p].[amount_units] >= 1000
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
    WHERE
      [m].[id] = [p].[merchant_id] AND [m].[status] = 'ACTIVE'
  )

output_fields: Customer ID, Merchant Name, Name, Email, Phone
report_criteria: Customers created in the last 12 months.
sql:
SELECT
  [c].[id] AS [Customer ID],
  [m].[name] AS [Merchant Name],
  [c].[name] AS [Name],
  [c].[email] AS [Email],
  [c].[phone] AS [Phone]
FROM [dbo].[customer] AS [c]
JOIN [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
  ON [m].[id] = [c].[merchant_id]
WHERE
  [c].[created_at] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, SYSUTCDATETIME())
  AND [c].[deleted_at] IS NULL

report_criteria: Customers who have at least one order with a status of Paid.
sql:
SELECT
  [c].[id] AS [Customer ID],
  [c].[name] AS [Name],
  [c].[email] AS [Email],
  [c].[phone] AS [Phone]
FROM [dbo].[customer] AS [c]
WHERE
  [c].[deleted_at] IS NULL
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM [dbo].[order_record] AS [o]
    WHERE
      [o].[customer_id] = [c].[id] AND [o].[order_status] = 'PAID'
  )

output_fields: Card ID, Brand, Last Four, Card Holder Name, Created At
report_criteria: Visa cards added in the last 6 months.
sql:
SELECT
  [v].[id] AS [Card ID],
  [v].[brand] AS [Brand],
  [v].[last_four] AS [Last Four],
  [v].[card_holder_name] AS [Card Holder Name],
  [v].[created_at] AS [Created At]
FROM [dbo].[vault_card] AS [v]
WHERE
  [v].[brand] = 'VISA'
  AND [v].[created_at] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, SYSUTCDATETIME())
  AND [v].[deleted_at] IS NULL

output_fields: Settlement ID, Merchant Name, Gross Amount, Net Amount, Status, Processed At
report_criteria: Settlements with a status of Processed, processed between 2026-01-01 and 2026-06-30.
sql:
SELECT
  [s].[id] AS [Settlement ID],
  [m].[name] AS [Merchant Name],
  [s].[gross_amount_units] AS [Gross Amount],
  [s].[net_amount_units] AS [Net Amount],
  [s].[status] AS [Status],
  [s].[processed_at] AS [Processed At]
FROM [dbo].[settlement] AS [s]
JOIN [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
  ON [m].[id] = [s].[merchant_id]
WHERE
  [s].[status] = 'PROCESSED'
  AND [s].[processed_at] >= '2026-01-01'
  AND [s].[processed_at] < '2026-07-01'

output_fields: User ID, Email, Role, Merchant Name, Created At
report_criteria: Dashboard users with a role of Admin.
sql:
SELECT
  [u].[id] AS [User ID],
  [u].[email] AS [Email],
  [u].[role] AS [Role],
  [m].[name] AS [Merchant Name],
  [u].[created_at] AS [Created At]
FROM [dbo].[app_user] AS [u]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[merchant] AS [m]
  ON [m].[id] = [u].[merchant_id]
WHERE
  [u].[role] = 'ADMIN'

output_fields: Webhook Event ID, Merchant ID, Event Type, Status, Attempts, Last Response Code, Last Attempt At
report_criteria: Webhook events with a status of Dead, where the last response code was 500 or higher.
sql:
SELECT
  [w].[id] AS [Webhook Event ID],
  [w].[merchant_id] AS [Merchant ID],
  [w].[event_type] AS [Event Type],
  [w].[status] AS [Status],
  [w].[attempts] AS [Attempts],
  [w].[last_response_code] AS [Last Response Code],
  [w].[last_attempt_at] AS [Last Attempt At]
FROM [dbo].[webhook_event] AS [w]
WHERE
  [w].[status] = 'DEAD' AND [w].[last_response_code] >= 500
